scope: Selected real plugin main bundle executed in isolated Node VM contexts against a mocked Figma API. The complete suite includes cancellation during importer font discovery. No native Figma runtime, browser transport, successful document creation, or rendering was verified.
mockLimits: showUI synchronously dispatches test messages to model an adversarial startup ordering; this does not establish the real Figma scheduler.
Relaunch failure is deliberately injected; no claim is made that Figma throws for an unknown relaunch command.
createImage records bytes only and does not decode images or upload to Figma.
No UI event.source, request timeout, cancellation UI, or cloud bootstrap behavior is tested here.

tests.name: Handler is registered before showUI; synchronous startup ping and begin receive immediate replies
Optional relaunch exception is contained; fonts, ping, and begin still answer
Begin validates session, name, and dimensions without replacing a valid session on failure
Array and Uint8Array assets work; duplicate, empty, and stale assets never call createImage
Cancel is session-scoped and repeatable; stale assets are rejected and a new begin can retry
A replacement begin invalidates a previous idle session and retains only the replacement session
An unresolved fonts promise does not block ping, begin, assets, or cancel
Cancel releases an import blocked on fonts that never settle; no nodes are created and begin can retry
Font resolution or rejection after cancellation neither creates nodes nor changes the replacement session
Font rejection and unknown operations return errors; malformed requests are ignored without throwing
